rights.title: Right to Equality
rights.simplified_summary: Guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws to all citizens, prohibiting discrimination on grounds of sex alone.
key_points: Prohibits arbitrary discrimination by the State.
Forms the basis for all gender-equality legislation in India.

rights.title: Special Provisions for Women
rights.simplified_summary: Empowers the State to make special positive discrimination provisions specifically for women and children.
key_points: Enables laws like reservations in local bodies, maternity benefits, and protective laws.
Ensures that affirmative action for women is constitutionally valid.

rights.title: Protection from Domestic Violence
rights.legal_provision: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
rights.simplified_summary: Protects women in a domestic relationship (wives, sisters, mothers, live-in partners) from physical, sexual, verbal, emotional, and economic abuse.
key_points: Right to reside in the shared household regardless of ownership.
Right to obtain protection orders, monetary relief, and custody orders.
Access to protection officers and medical help.

rights.title: Prohibition of Dowry
rights.simplified_summary: Bans the giving, taking, or demanding of dowry (property or valuable security given in connection with marriage).
key_points: Demanding dowry is a punishable criminal offense.
Presents given to the bride must be registered in a designated list and belong exclusively to her (Stri-dhan).

rights.title: Right to a Safe Workplace (POSH)
rights.legal_provision: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
rights.simplified_summary: Protects women from sexual harassment at all workplaces (both public/private and formal/informal sectors) and provides a clear mechanism for redressal.
key_points: Mandatory Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) in workplaces with 10 or more employees.
Covers physical contact, demanding sexual favors, making sexually colored remarks, or showing pornography.
Strict timelines for completing inquiries (90 days) and maintaining confidentiality.

rights.title: Maternity Benefits and Job Security
rights.simplified_summary: Regulates the employment of women in certain establishments before and after childbirth and provides for maternity and other benefits.
key_points: Entitles working women to 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave.
Mandatory crèche facility for establishments employing 50 or more employees.
Illegal for an employer to dismiss or discharge a woman during her maternity leave.
